phases.name: Investigate what was blocked or kept
phases.detail: 3 of 3 tables cleared, 0 of 1 queries fixed

rules.name: ca_street_number_shape
rules.expression: ca_street_number IS NULL OR (length(cast(ca_street_number AS string)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4)
rules.why: Databricks text is 1 to 4 characters long

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(`ca_street_number`) AS c0_n, MIN(LENGTH(`ca_street_number`)) AS c0_lo, MAX(LENGTH(`ca_street_number`)) AS c0_hi FROM workspace.nirvana_tpcds.customer_address
CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore
CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore.nirvana

COMPILE USL IF NOT EXISTS guard_nirvana_csv_customer_address DEPLOY NAMESPACE lightning.metastore.nirvana DDL
CREATE TABLE customer_address (ca_address_sk int, ca_address_id varchar(1000), ca_street_number int, ca_street_name varchar(1000), ca_street_type varchar(1000), ca_suite_number varchar(1000), ca_city varchar(1000), ca_county varchar(1000), ca_state varchar(1000), ca_zip int, ca_country varchar(1000), ca_gmt_offset double, ca_location_type varchar(1000))

ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.nirvana.guard_nirvana_csv_customer_address.customer_address AS SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_address_id, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type FROM NIRVANA_CSV.customer_address

REGISTER DQ ca_street_number_shape TABLE lightning.metastore.nirvana.guard_nirvana_csv_customer_address.customer_address AS ca_street_number IS NULL OR (length(cast(ca_street_number AS string)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4)

rules.name: ca_zip_shape

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(`ca_zip`) AS c0_n, MIN(LENGTH(`ca_zip`)) AS c0_lo, MAX(LENGTH(`ca_zip`)) AS c0_hi FROM workspace.nirvana_tpcds.customer_address
CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore
CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore.nirvana

COMPILE USL IF NOT EXISTS guard_nirvana_csv_customer_address DEPLOY NAMESPACE lightning.metastore.nirvana DDL
CREATE TABLE customer_address (ca_address_sk int, ca_address_id varchar(1000), ca_street_number int, ca_street_name varchar(1000), ca_street_type varchar(1000), ca_suite_number varchar(1000), ca_city varchar(1000), ca_county varchar(1000), ca_state varchar(1000), ca_zip int, ca_country varchar(1000), ca_gmt_offset double, ca_location_type varchar(1000))

ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.nirvana.guard_nirvana_csv_customer_address.customer_address AS SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_address_id, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type FROM NIRVANA_CSV.customer_address
REGISTER DQ ca_zip_shape TABLE lightning.metastore.nirvana.guard_nirvana_csv_customer_address.customer_address AS ca_zip IS NULL OR (length(cast(ca_zip AS string)) = 5)
